notes:
Dual Mode is a lot more reliable, and the logo is sharp.

**A piece now arrives on the second tablet complete, in one go.** Opening a piece the second tablet didn't have used to send the PDF and then a stream of separate messages for your cropping, deskewing, page rotations, handwriting, pistons, links, markings and bookmarks — and any of those could arrive before the piece itself had finished landing, in which case they were simply lost. That's why cropping sometimes never showed up on the second tablet. Everything now travels together as one file, so there is nothing left to lose. Transfers are noticeably quicker too.

**The second tablet no longer sits on its library screen ignoring you.** If it was showing its own library, pieces you opened on the main tablet were being opened underneath it, out of sight, and the only cure was unpairing and pairing again. It now brings the music forward by itself.

**The second tablet no longer comes up blank when you pair from the library**, and handwriting no longer vanishes when you leave edit mode from it.

**Page turns from the second tablet no longer occasionally go missing.**

**Pen buzz settings now travel from the main tablet to the second one.** Set these on the MAIN tablet — the second one takes its settings from it.

**The Obbligato logo is sharp.** The idle screen was stretching a small icon; it now uses a full-resolution one. The app icon is sharper everywhere too.

Nothing was ever lost in any of these — your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
